say:1:1022029001:1.text: Am I seeing things? Is it snowing again?!
say:1:1022029001:1.source_cn: 是我看错了吗？怎么又下雪了？！
say:1:1022029001:1.male: Am I seeing things? Is it snowing again?!
say:1:1022029001:1.female: Am I seeing things? Is it snowing again?!

say:3:1022029002:1.text: This is incredible... Dura above, I always thought Ryeham had it all—except snow during the Winter Carnival. Without it, the festival never quite felt complete.
say:3:1022029002:1.source_cn: ……太好了，艾雅在上，我之前一直觉得，金穗村哪里都好，...
say:3:1022029002:1.male: This is incredible... Dura above, I always thought Ryeham had it all—except snow during the Winter Carnival. Without it, the festival never quite felt complete.
say:3:1022029002:1.female: This is incredible... Dura above, I always thought Ryeham had it all—except snow during the Winter Carnival. Without it, the festival never quite felt complete.

say:4:1022029003:1.text: I can't believe we've been blessed with snow this year. Thank you so much for making it happen.
say:4:1022029003:1.source_cn: 没想到今年居然能迎来幸运的降雪，多谢你们的帮助了。
say:4:1022029003:1.male: I can't believe we've been blessed with snow this year. Thank you so much for making it happen.
say:4:1022029003:1.female: I can't believe we've been blessed with snow this year. Thank you so much for making it happen.

say:5:1022029004:1.text: Lately, the village has seen so many visitors. Scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory, merchants from the Mithril Consortium, and even students from the Serene Lyceum.
say:5:1022029004:1.source_cn: 这段时间，村里来了不少人，冬青学会的学者，秘银商会的商...
say:5:1022029004:1.male: Lately, the village has seen so many visitors. Scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory, merchants from the Mithril Consortium, and even students from the Serene Lyceum.
say:5:1022029004:1.female: Lately, the village has seen so many visitors. Scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory, merchants from the Mithril Consortium, and even students from the Serene Lyceum.

say:6:1022029005:0.text: With all of them coming through, life here just keeps getting better and better—
say:6:1022029005:0.source_cn: 托他们的福，这边的日子也越过越好了——
say:6:1022029005:0.male: With all of them coming through, life here just keeps getting better and better—
say:6:1022029005:0.female: With all of them coming through, life here just keeps getting better and better—

say:14:1022029007:0.text: G-gruglins?! Why are they suddenly here?!
say:14:1022029007:0.source_cn: 咕！咕布林？！这时候怎么会突然有咕布林！
say:14:1022029007:0.male: G-gruglins?! Why are they suddenly here?!
say:14:1022029007:0.female: G-gruglins?! Why are they suddenly here?!

say:16:1022029008:1.text: Are they after food again, like when they stole the grapes last time? Hmph! Chippy won't let them get away with it!
say:16:1022029008:1.source_cn: 又像之前抢葡萄一样来打劫食物吗，哼，满满绝不允许！
say:16:1022029008:1.male: Are they after food again, like when they stole the grapes last time? Hmph! Chippy won't let them get away with it!
say:16:1022029008:1.female: Are they after food again, like when they stole the grapes last time? Hmph! Chippy won't let them get away with it!

narration:18:12605306:0.text: Halfway through your conversation with the priest, some gruglins assaulted the village!
narration:18:12605306:0.source_cn: 你们正在与司铎交代下雪事宜的时候，突然，有咕布林袭击了这里！

choice:2:0:1.text: Mirael and I adjusted the ward.
choice:2:0:1.male: Mirael and I adjusted the ward.
choice:2:0:1.female: Mirael and I adjusted the ward.

choice:2:1:2.text: It's because of me! Praise me!
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: （解释下雪原因，顺便夸夸自己）
choice:2:1:2.male: It's because of me! Praise me!
choice:2:1:2.female: It's because of me! Praise me!
